description: Opaque dark forest-green knee-length wool tunic, with broad tan and gold Celtic knotwork edging down its front, at the cuffs and around the hem. Cream undershirt visible at the neck and wrists. A heavy green cloak crosses the chest from one shoulder, secured with a round gold brooch, with gold knotwork borders and fringed edges. Wide brown leather belt carries round ornamental metal plaques and a long decorated hanging strap. Brown trousers and tall dark brown boots complete the outfit. The fitted shoulders and sleeves cover a broad muscular frame. No armor, weapon or headgear is visible.
